title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Each input has exactly one solution. You may not use the same element twice.

title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome, and false otherwise. An integer is a palindrome when it reads the same forward and backward.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s of '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', ']', determine if the input string is valid. Open brackets must be closed by the same type, in the correct order, with every close bracket having a corresponding open bracket.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given prices[] where prices[i] is the stock price on day i. You want to maximize profit by choosing one day to buy and a later day to sell. Return the maximum profit, or 0 if no profit is possible.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s. An Anagram is a word formed by rearranging the letters of another, using all the original letters exactly once.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted integer array nums and integer target, return the index of target if found, else -1. You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime complexity.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase. It takes n steps to reach the top. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

title: Missing Number
description: Given an array nums containing n distinct numbers in [0,n], return the only number in that range missing from the array.

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice, and false if every element is distinct.

title: Single Number
description: Given a non-empty array nums where every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one. Must use linear runtime and only constant extra space.
constraints: Each element appears twice except for one.
